test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act included Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Forty-second Amendment Act.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **42nd Amendment** also attached a new segment to the Article on **"Fundamental Duties" **in the Constitution. 
 
• The new segment prescribed citizens **"to promote coordination and the spirit of common brotherhood in the middle of all the people of India, transcending religious, linguistic and regional or sectional diversities."**
 
• 42nd Constitution (Amendment) Act, 1976, a **new Chapter IV-A** which be composed of only one Article i.e **51-A** was attached which dealt with a** Code of Ten Fundamental Duties for citizens.**
 
• There are** 11 Fundamental Duties for Indian Citizens** formulated on the lines of moral, ethical and culture code of conduct followed by people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** twenty-second amendment p**rescribes the formation of an autonomous State comprising certain tribal areas in Assam and the creation of a local Legislature or Council of Ministers or both therefore.
 
• The** 52nd Amendment Act of 1985 **is known as **Anti-Defection Law** due to it provided for the disqualification of members of Parliament and state legislatures on the ground of defection and attached a **new Tenth Schedule holding the details in this regard.**
 
• **Thirty-second Amendment Act **mentioned that no Soldier shall, in time of peace be quartered in any house, without the consent of the Owner, nor in time of war, but in a way to be ordered by law.
